title: Algoritm so'zi xorazmlik olim nomidan kelgan

scenes.text: Algoritm so'zi xorazmlik olim nomidan kelgan.
Al-Xorazmiy IX asrda yashagan, ismi esa "xorazmlik" degan ma'noni bildiradi.
Uning kitobi nomidagi al-jabr so'zidan algebra atamasi chiqqan.
Telefoningizdagi har bir algoritm ham uning nomini eslatadi.

description: Algoritm so'zi IX asrda yashagan olim al-Xorazmiy nomining lotincha shaklidan, algebra esa uning kitobidagi al-jabr so'zidan kelib chiqqan.
source: https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/entry/Muhammad_ibn_Mūsā_al-Khwārizmī (name Latinised as algoritmi; al-jabr to algebra; Khwarazm origin per Ibn al-Nadim, birthplace debated); https://findanexpert.unimelb.edu.au/news/81898-why-are-algorithms-called-algorithms
